adds.title: ILGA-Europe Rainbow Index - 2016, 2019, 2024 rankings
adds.summary: In 2026 Russia, including Dagestan, scored 2% among the lowest in Europe and maintained explicit bans/legal limitations making legal gender recognition practically impossible.

adds.title: Supreme Court of Russia ruling November 2023 - 'international LGBT public movement' as extremist
adds.summary: On 30 November 2023 the Supreme Court of Russia designated the 'international LGBT public movement' as extremist and banned it nationwide including Ingushetia, prohibiting LGBT including trans advocacy, organizing and public display of symbols and exposing violators to extremism-related fines, detention and imprisonment.
